title: OpenDEA Maturity Level
description: A model-owned maturity level within a MaturityScale (CR-AM-09 §8–§13). The level identifier is structural (L0, L1, L2, …); the name and definition carry the model's semantics. The metamodel never prescribes a global five-level shape — different maturity models legitimately use different identifiers, names, level counts, and semantic interpretations. A level is canonical only within (MaturityModel, MaturityScale, MaturityLevel) (CR-AM-09 §9). The ordinal supports ordering within a scale; it never implies cross-model equivalence or fixed progression difficulty.

id.description: Level identifier within its scale (structural, e.g. 'L0', 'L1', 'L3', 'A2', 'Phase 2'). Cross-model equivalent: never assumed.

ordinal.description: Position within the scale's ordered progression. Supports ordering only; never implies cross-model equivalence or progression difficulty.

name.description: Model-defined name for the level (e.g. 'Absent', 'Not Present', 'Unaware' — all valid L0 names in different models).

definition.description: Explicit definition: what the level actually represents in this model's terms. Mandatory.

characteristics.description: Observable properties associated with the level — descriptive, not scoring rules.
